item.title: Elmhurst University Turning Point USA fights for recognition
item.description: University says it is 'monitoring the situation' but won't commit to just approving the Turning Point USA chapter.

item.title: Catholic university in Wis. warns against using word ‘illegal,’ too ‘stigmatizing’
item.description: Faculty and staff at a private Catholic university in Wisconsin this week were warned against using the word 'illegal,' as it is too 'stigmatizing.'

item.title: Professor sues Texas A&M after firing over gender identity lessons in children’s lit class
item.description: An English professor filed a lawsuit against Texas A&M University, claiming her free speech and due process rights were violated after being fired for teaching gender ideology in a children's literature class.

item.title: After Florida AG declares Hispanic-only scholarship illegal, questions remain

item.description: The Pregnant Students’ Rights Act, a Republican-backed bill introduced by Sen. Ashley Moody, recently failed in the Senate after a party-line cloture vote of 47-45 fell short of the required 60 votes. The legislation would have required colleges and universities participating in federal student aid programs to inform prospective and enrolled students about their rights […]

item.title: UCLA museum removes hundreds of Native American artifacts, photos at tribe’s request
item.description: UCLA's Fowler Museum is repatriating hundreds of Native American artifacts to the Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation, raising concerns among some scholars about potential impacts on research.

item.title: ‘Goodlooking blonde’ email to Epstein draws protest of Yale professor
item.description: He once told Jeffrey Epstein about an attractive student to hire. That drew protests this week.

item.description: Professor Maya Jasanoff, expected to be the next chair of Harvard's History Department, espouses leftist views online.
